steps: Opened FinOps on the project scope; the inspected initial page showed five existing Virtual Key ceilings and no project ceiling.
Created a monthly project budget ceiling of 2500000 micro-USD through the real Console.
Opened Create budget again for the same project/month and entered 3000000 micro-USD.
Submitted the duplicate Create action and read the matching budget through the authenticated Admin API.

duplicate_create.ui_error: A budget already exists for this scope and period. Update the existing limit instead of creating a duplicate.

limitations: Only Owner, monthly Project scope, Chromium and SQLite were retested.
